summary: The PR addresses the issue of pylint crashing when running with --jobs=0 in a Kubernetes environment by ensuring that the number of CPUs is at least 1. The proposed change is minimal and directly fixes the problem.

issues.description: The addition of new test files (test_package/my_package/__init__.py, test_package/my_package/example.py, test_package/reproduce.py) is unrelated to the core fix and could be considered scope creep. However, since these files are part of the reproduction test and not the actual fix, they are acceptable.
